description: INK v0.1 key rotation test vectors — auth header keyId extension, rotated-key verification, revoked-key rejection and refresh-on-miss. All scenarios use runtime-generated keys (not static fixtures) and are exercised by test/ink-key-rotation-phase3.test.ts.

vectors.description: Authorization header includes optional keyId parameter after signature
After rotation, new key signs messages. Verifier with [old=retired, new=active] keyset accepts.

scenario.step2: Agent rotates: keyV1 retired, keyV2 active, keyV1 private wiped
scenario.step3: Agent signs with keyV2, includes keyId=sig-v2 in auth header
scenario.step4: Counterparty resolves keyset from Agent Card: [sig-v1=retired, sig-v2=active]

vectors.description: Messages signed before rotation still verify against retired key in keyset

scenario.step1: Message signed with keyV1 at T=2026-03-20
scenario.step2: Key rotated at T=2026-03-25: keyV1 retired, keyV2 active
scenario.step3: Counterparty verifies old message with keyset [sig-v1=retired, sig-v2=active]

vectors.description: Messages signed with a revoked key are rejected even if cryptographically valid

scenario.step2: Attacker signs message with compromised key, sets keyId=sig-compromised

vectors.description: When all cached keys fail to verify, receiver refetches Agent Card and retries

scenario.step1: Receiver has stale cache with only keyV1
scenario.step2: Sender rotated to keyV2 and signs message with it
scenario.step4: Receiver fetches fresh Agent Card: [sig-v1=retired, sig-v2=active]

constraints.note: Only one refresh attempt per verification to prevent infinite loops

vectors.description: When keyId appears in both auth header and message body (signingKeyId), the auth header takes precedence for verification hint

scenario.note: Header is transport-layer; body is application-layer. Transport takes precedence for the verifier.

vectors.description: When header keyId references a key not in the keyset, verifier falls through to normal iteration

scenario.result: Hinted key not found → skip hint → iterate active keys → verified with sig-actual

vectors.description: INK audit events record signingKeyId in data field so historical events can be verified against the correct key

data.note: Verifiers use this to select the correct key from the agent's historical keyset
